items.title: EIP-7951: Precompile for secp256r1 Curve Support
items.description: Adds P256VERIFY precompile at address 0x100 for secp256r1 ECDSA signature verification (6900 gas). Enables native support for Apple Secure Enclave, Android Keystore, and FIDO2/WebAuthn. Supersedes RIP-7212 with security fixes.

items.title: Fulu -- The Beacon Chain
items.description: Fulu consensus-layer beacon chain specification. Includes EIP-7594 (PeerDAS), EIP-7917 (deterministic proposer lookahead), and EIP-7892 (blob parameter only hardforks). Defines modified process_execution_payload, BeaconState with proposer_lookahead, BlobParameters, and compute_fork_digest.

items.title: Fulu -- Data Availability Sampling Core
items.description: Core DAS specification for Fulu. Defines DataColumnSidecar, MatrixEntry containers, custody groups (NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS=128, CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT=4, SAMPLES_PER_SLOT=8), get_custody_groups, compute_columns_for_custody_group, compute_matrix, and recover_matrix.

items.title: Fulu -- Fork Choice
items.description: Fork choice modification for Fulu. Modifies is_data_available to use column sidecars (retrieve_column_sidecars) instead of blob retrieval, and verifies data column sidecar KZG proofs.

items.title: Fulu -- Fork
items.description: Describes the Fulu upgrade process. Triggered at FULU_FORK_EPOCH. Defines upgrade_to_fulu function that transitions from Electra BeaconState, adding proposer_lookahead field (EIP-7917).

items.title: Fulu -- Networking (P2P Interface)
items.description: Consensus-layer networking spec for Fulu. Defines data column sidecar subnets (128), verification helpers, gossip topics, deprecated blob_sidecar topics, DataColumnSidecarsByRange/Root req/resp, ENR structure with custody group count and next fork digest, supernode specifications.

items.title: Fulu -- Polynomial Commitments Sampling
items.description: Extends polynomial-commitments with DAS functions. Defines Cell type (64 field elements), CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB=128, compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs, verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch, recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs. Includes FFT helpers, KZG multiproofs, and reconstruction algorithms.

items.title: Fulu -- Honest Validator
items.description: Honest validator guide for Fulu. Defines VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT=8, BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP=32 ETH, modified BlobsBundle with cell KZG proofs, get_data_column_sidecars construction, sidecar publishing and retention requirements.

items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Blocks
items.description: Defines Block, Header, Withdrawal, Log, and Receipt data structures for the Osaka fork. Header includes blob_gas_used, excess_blob_gas, parent_beacon_block_root, and requests_hash fields.

items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Bloom
items.description: Implements Ethereum logs bloom filter functions: add_to_bloom and logs_bloom for the Osaka fork.
